facts.fact: Dr Houssein Ahmed Assoweh, author of the UNESCO readiness report, says Djibouti has no legal framework designed specifically for AI systems, though the Code du numérique and data-protection texts may apply; a framework law and an AI authority are only recommended.

DJI.note: It says AI is entering administrations but names no body or system.
It lists possible sector uses and names no tool in service or under way.
It mentions university research on Somali language models but no released model, dataset or computing.

facts.fact: Dr Houssein Ahmed Assoweh lists the Startup Act among the texts Djibouti already has, and the roadmap recommends adapting its mechanisms to AI-using firms.

DJI.note: A national AI innovation hub and incubators are only recommended, none is built or open.
